question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word.**

She is a **__veteran__** journalist known for her powerful writing style.
solution:
The correct answer is "Novice."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The word "Veteran" means a person of long experience usually in some occupation or skill (such as politics or the arts) veteran adjective. (आमतौर पर किसी व्यवसाय या कौशल (जैसे राजनीति या कला) में लंबे अनुभव वाला व्यक्ति अनुभवी विशेषण)

 
 
• Example: *She's also a **veteran**__ campaigner for human rights.*
 
 
 
• ​The antonym of "Veteran" is "Novice."
 
• The word "Novice" means a person who is new and without experience in a certain job, situation, etc. (किसी विशेष काम, परिसि्‍थति आदि के लिए नया और अनुभवहीन व्यक्ति; नौसिखिया)
 __
 
• Example:* This plant can be difficult for **novice**__ gardeners to grow*.
 
 
 
• ​So, the correct answer is Option 4.**
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** 

 
• Renowned: **known or talked about by many people; famous. (प्रसिद्घ)
 
• **Creviced: **a narrow opening caused by a split or crack : fissure. (दरारयुक्त)
 
• **Conditioned: **to affect or control the way that somebody/something behaves. (किसी के व्‍यवहार को प्रभावित या नियंत्रित करना; रीति-विशेष से अनुकूलित करना)
